name: HaoWei1: Your Domineering Warlord
detailed_description:
"HaoWei 1" is a female-oriented 3D visual novel otome game, blending sweet romance and a murder mystery.

▌Plot of "HaoWei 1":
◆ Romance Part: The military leader brother, HaoWei, deeply loves you and cannot bear to see you, as a talent agent, running around and exhausting yourself. He wants to arrange a leisure position for you in the military, so you can manage the military band, but you kindly refuse. Male idol Panda is exhausted from shooting and falls asleep as soon as he returns to his hotel room. Since there is only this room, you sleep on a chair in the hotel to avoid suspicion. After hearing about this, HaoWei becomes furious and personally meets Panda to scold him harshly. He cannot stand seeing you suffer even the slightest distress. HaoWei meets your fiancé, White Bear, at a car dealership, where they both happen to be selecting expensive cars suitable for a talent agent. They both like the same model…
◆ Murder Mystery Part: In this episode of "HaoWei 1", your artist Panda gets involved in a murder case where a woman was strangled with brown tape. The victim was the mother of a child model, and she was wrapped up with the tape in a terrifying way. Many people were present at the scene; who would dare commit such a crime? Why would they use such a tedious and strange method to kill her? How did the murderer carry out the crime? To clear Panda's name and protect his reputation, you, as his agent, must immediately find clues, solve the mystery, and identify the real killer!

▌Game Content
Over 1000 exquisite dynamic 3D video clips
All characters have full voice acting and sound effects
You can collect his heartbeat, temperature, and breath to unlock different rooms and find clues to solve the murder mystery
Unlock 10 interactive features: he will call you, send messages, accompany you, and even lull you to sleep
In addition to the main storyline, there are 10 side stories with different choices leading to different endings
Unlock 3 fun mini-games
Unlock 10 theme songs

▌About the Bear Kingdom
The Bear Kingdom is a newly established nation after the third world war. After a period of warlord conflicts, it is now controlled by the brown bear warlord, HaoWei, who governs the southern part of the country. His power is solid, the economy is developing rapidly, and the culture is inclusive and diverse.

▌Brown Bear and You

HaoWei: Nicknamed "Brown Bear", as a military leader, he is tough, dignified, and cold-hearted, but he reserves all his tenderness for you. When you were young, you two became siblings through your parents' remarriage, and over time, you developed feelings for each other. Brown Bear HaoWei does everything to protect and pamper you. However, your stepfather, the old warlord, arranged for you to marry White Bear, the son of a wealthy man in the Bear Kingdom, which makes HaoWei furious. He only wants to marry you and must take back his bride…


You: As a talent agent, you work hard to help the idol Panda develop his career. You help him find acting opportunities, organize music albums, arrange live events, handle business negotiations, and more. You love your career as an agent and devote yourself fully to it.

▌The Other Three Bears

QianYi: Nicknamed "White Bear", he is the young president of the Bear Kingdom's largest department store, White Bear Department Store. His family is old money, traditional, and arrogant. Although you were engaged to White Bear when you were a child, now that you are an agent, his family greatly despises the entertainment industry and demands that you abandon it. They want you to pursue a financial career you have no interest in. White Bear loves your energetic and hardworking personality, and he pressures you to fulfill the engagement… He believes that traditional department stores must be thoroughly reformed to attract younger people, so he invites the idol Panda to perform at the store.


HengQi: Nicknamed "Panda", you and Panda have been best friends since elementary school, and later, you became his agent. Despite his extraordinary talent in performance, singing, and dancing, Panda's career has been rocky, and he keeps getting involved in various murder cases, becoming a criminal suspect. You must do everything you can to find clues, solve the cases, and clear Panda’s name.


MoMo: Nicknamed "Black Bear", a detective in the police force, MoMo graduated with honors from the police academy and entered the homicide division as the youngest member. He can quickly identify suspects and solve cases by picking up on subtle clues. Every time there's a murder case, he runs into you, and thus, you two get acquainted…

▌Gameplay
Watch the Story/Make Choices: Enjoy a movie-like story and progress in your romance with him. Collect his smile, heartbeat, warmth, and unlock different rooms to find clues to the murder and puzzles.
Mini-games: Play mini-games to collect important puzzle pieces and solve mysteries to crack the case.
Daily Interactions: Interact with him through phone calls, text messages, and reading his diary.
Songs and Video Clips: Listen to songs and revisit important video clips.

▌The Four Bears Series
Since this sub-series focuses on the bond between you and the four "bears"—idol Panda, military leader HaoWei, wealthy fiancé White Bear, and detective MoMo, it’s named the "Four Bears Series" (a part of the 1000 Princes series). Each episode is named after one of the bears, with this episode focusing on the romance between you and HaoWei. Each episode of the Four Bears Series contains both sweet romance and a murder mystery!

▌1000 Princes Series
The 1000 Princes otome game series is a female-targeted romance game series with a heartwarming 3D visual novel style. Players can choose different princes to experience a glamorous and sweet romance. Each game in the series is named after a different prince, each of whom deeply cares for, pampers, protects, supports, and loves you.
"1000 Princes" is a large-scale romantic series for women! It includes a sweet romance otome game series and easy-to-understand multilingual learning e-books.
🍰 "1000 Princes" otome games: Available on STEAM and Google Play
📕 "1000 Princes" multilingual learning e-books: Available on Google Play
└ 🅿️ "1000 Princes" developer "Ginyan" multilingual learning: On YouTube
🍒 "1000 Princes" theme songs: On YouTube
🌸 "1000 Princes" official website

▌Developer Introduction
Ginyan: I am an independent developer of otome games/visual novels and also an e-book author. I create foreign language learning books and romantic fiction e-books. I love fantasy and have a deep passion for learning about computers and foreign languages. I use my own novels as scripts for games, develop them using the Unity engine and Naninovel, create character modeling and animation using iClone and CC, and incorporate various AI tools to develop my games.
